standard_prerequisites.name: The boundary map beta on the cohomology of the quotient complexes fM/f^2M, M/f^2M, M/fM computes the obstruction to lifting kernels of d mod f to kernels of d mod f^2
The Bockstein beta factors through a map whose target detects the f-torsion of H^{i+1}(M)
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows nonzero beta forces H^{i+1}(M)[f] nonzero.

core_obligations: By construction beta is the boundary map on cohomology attached to the short exact sequence of complexes 0 -> fM/f^2M -> M/f^2M -> M/fM -> 0, up to isomorphism; the long exact cohomology sequence then identifies the obstruction to lifting Ker(d^i mod f) into Ker(d^i mod f^2) with the image of beta, giving the equivalence of (1) and (2) (proof lines 27797-27801). If beta is nonzero, the factorization of the Bockstein maps shows the class has nonzero preimage killed by f in H^{i+1}(M), so H^{i+1}(M)[f] is nonzero; contrapositively H^{i+1}(M)[f] = 0 implies the equivalent conditions (proof lines 27801-27803).
proof_roadmap: Identify beta with the boundary map of the mod-f short exact sequence and read off the equivalence (proof lines 27797-27801).
Use the factorization to force f-torsion from a nonzero beta (proof lines 27801-27803).
difficulty_reason: 9 行、Bockstein β 的零化与模 f 核的提升：β 即短正合列 0 -> fM/f²M -> M/f²M -> M/fM -> 0 的上同调边缘映射，其长正合列把「Ker(d^i mod f) 能提升到 Ker(d^i mod f²)」与 β=0 等价起来；β≠0 时由 Bockstein 的因子分解式（0GSP）在 H^{i+1}(M) 中产生非零 f-挠，故 H^{i+1}(M)[f]=0 蕴含两等价条件。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
